metadata.description: Native compositor plugins plus explicitly portable Claude-format examples. See docs/marketplace.md for runtime compatibility.

plugins.name: auto-approve
plugins.description: Opt-in risk review for arbitrary console, plugin, MCP and workflow tool actions. Only low-risk decisions pass automatically; explicit denies remain binding.

plugins.name: btw
plugins.description: /btw <question> — ask a side question answered in isolation by a fresh model call (Claude Code /btw analog: the answer lands as a notification and never enters the conversation). Drop this folder to remove.

plugins.name: callix
plugins.description: Native Callix navigation with bounded graph/source results, guarded symbol edit anchors, fresh shared indexing and token-size estimates; replace through service.project.query.

plugins.name: checkpoint-history
plugins.description: Turn snapshots for code and conversation, with conflict-aware restore and review.

plugins.name: checkpoints
plugins.description: Pre-write file checkpoints (Claude Code rewind analog): write/edit tool calls snapshot the previous content; /rewind restores the most recent snapshot. Journal: .agent-compositor/checkpoints.json. Drop this folder to remove.

plugins.name: cost
plugins.description: /cost and /usage — token accounting from turn.usage events (Claude Code /cost analog). Tally survives across turns in plugin state; drop this folder to remove.

plugins.name: doctor
plugins.description: /doctor — sanity report: env vars (AGENT_BASE_URL/AGENT_API_KEY/AGENT_MODEL) and a live provider ping (Claude Code /doctor analog). Drop this folder to remove.

plugins.name: export
plugins.description: /export — dump the session transcript (your prompts + assistant text) to .agent-compositor/session-<id>.md (Claude Code /export analog). Buffer caps at 100k chars. Drop this folder to remove.

plugins.name: guard-scope
plugins.description: Workspace jail for write/edit tools: paths escaping the session cwd are denied regardless of config permissions (belt over the builtin rules' suspenders). Drop this folder to remove.

plugins.name: guard-secrets
plugins.description: Blocks private keys and API tokens from reaching the model or tool arguments (AWS AKIA…, OpenAI sk-…, GitHub ghp_…, Slack xoxb-…, PEM blocks). Drop this folder to remove.

plugins.name: mascot
plugins.description: Replaceable animated APNG companion reacting to agent, tool, dialog and planning events.

plugins.name: mcp
plugins.description: MCP client: expose stdio MCP servers' tools to the model through the mcp_call gateway. Servers come from AGENT_MCP_CONFIG (JSON, Claude-style mcpServers) or <cwd>/.agent-compositor/mcp.json.

plugins.name: memory
plugins.description: COMPOSITOR.md project memory — GEMINI.md / CLAUDE.md analog. `# <note>` appends to the memory file; every prompt gets the memory prepended as context. Drop this folder to remove.

plugins.name: monty
plugins.description: Replaceable Python sandbox provider using Monty. No filesystem, network or shell capabilities are supplied.

plugins.name: network-proxy
plugins.description: Optional HTTP CONNECT proxy for model streams and network tools, with child-process proxy environment.

plugins.name: notify-done
plugins.description: Desktop notification when a turn finishes or fails — the Claude Code Notification / codex notify hook analog, so you can look away while the agent works. Drop this folder to remove.

plugins.name: output-style
plugins.description: Output style for assistant text (Claude Code output-styles analog). /style terse strips filler openers ('Sure!', 'Certainly!'…), /style off disables. Rewrites assistant.text pre-render, so this plugin is trusted (render-only hooks see the opaque element tree). Drop this folder to remove.

plugins.name: plan-mode
plugins.description: Plan mode (Claude Code /plan analog): toggle with /plan — the model gets a read-only reminder, every write/exec call is denied until you toggle it off. Drop this folder to remove.

plugins.name: plugin-author
plugins.description: Create and improve Compositor plugins from a request: bundled skill, current contracts, starter files and non-executing structure checks.

plugins.name: session-ctl
plugins.description: /compact — force context compaction now; /clear — drop the conversation, keep the system prompt (Claude Code /compact and /clear analogs). Both ride $.agent. Drop this folder to remove.

plugins.name: slash-commands
plugins.description: /help, /status, /usage — command palette harvested from Claude Code / Gemini CLI slash-command UX. Drop this folder to remove.

plugins.name: todos
plugins.description: Persistent task list window. Restores tasks on startup, updates after todo tool calls, and opens with /todos. Placement is controlled by the compositor.

plugins.name: turn-log
plugins.description: Append-only JSONL journal of every turn (prompt, outcome, error) at .agent-compositor/turn-log.jsonl — the /stats data source. Drop this folder to remove.

plugins.name: ui-theme
plugins.description: Switch between slate, amber and mono themes. Demonstrates appearance and ui.render overrides.

plugins.name: web
plugins.description: Bounded web reading and keyless DuckDuckGo or configurable Brave/SearXNG search through normal tool permissions.

plugins.name: workflows
plugins.description: Replaceable dynamic background workflows with persistent dependency stages, bounded parallelism, expansion, conditional branches, pause/resume/retry and Python/Monty journal compatibility.

plugins.name: portable-example
plugins.description: Portable namespaced command example for Claude Code and Agent Compositor.
